terrain_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production terrain texture atlas for TWILIGHT, a classic Korean isometric dark fantasy 2D RPG. Generate a square 2048x2048 opaque image divided into EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, equal square cells, edge to edge, no borders, no gaps, no labels. Each cell is a flat overhead seamless material texture, NO perspective, NO objects, evenly lit, detailed painterly semi-realistic pre-rendered game texture. Restrained small details, broad natural variation, readable not noisy at game scale. Cell order row-major: row1 muted woodland moss grass; warm packed earth fine gravel; weathered beige limestone town paving small irregular stones; shaded forest floor grass soil. Row2 cold gray ancient dungeon flagstones; dusty cracked flagstones; dark engraved basalt fortress tiles; soot black rough basalt. Row3 ashen volcanic ground; damp olive moss swamp earth; pale chalky limestone cavern ground; pale blue-gray mineral stone floor. Row4 ivory temple stone subtle gold seams; worn ivory mosaic flagstones; gray-green ruined courtyard moss paving; dark reddish volcanic rock faint ember cracks. Keep material features proportional across cells. No words, no logos, no monsters, no buildings, no black separating lines. New original game art, not copied existing screenshots.
props_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production isometric environmental sprite atlas for classic dark fantasy Korean RPG TWILIGHT. One square image, EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal cells on genuine transparent background. Each cell contains ONE isolated object centered horizontally, feet at 90% of cell height, generous empty margin, no contact between cells. Consistent 2:1 isometric projection (roughly 30 degrees elevated camera), realistic hand-painted pre-rendered videogame sprites, natural muted stone and timber colors, crisp silhouettes, lit upper left. No text, no labels, no logos, NO floors or diamond pedestals under objects. Row 1: medieval timber stone cottage with red-brown shingle roof; small market stall green canvas canopy crates; lush oak tree; tall dark pine tree. Row 2: waist high stone-edged flower planter yellow-green grasses; short worn stone wall section; old stone arch portal with teal glow; two stacked wooden crates. Row 3: dark gothic ruined pillar; spiky black basalt rock; pale limestone stalagmite cluster; luminous cyan mineral crystal cluster. Row 4: ivory gold-trimmed temple column; small ivory shrine with warm glow; leafless swamp tree; ancient ruined gray stone doorway. Each sprite should fill 70 to 80 percent of its own cell, NEVER span neighboring cells. Transparent outside silhouettes. New original artwork.
classification: newly authored game assets; reference images not redistributed
